title: DebugMode silently disables torch.compile
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Self explanatory. 

```
V0929 08:06:25.203000 1331468 /data/users/ezyang/b/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/convert_frame.py:1968] skipping: forward (reason: non-infra torch dispatch mode present, this is not supported today in torch.compile, file: /data/users/ezyang/b/autoparallel/autoparallel/_testing/models/llama3.py)
```

At minimum we should error when this occurs, but it would be better for DebugMode to work when you have a backend like aot_eager.

cc @chauhang @penguinwu @SherlockNoMad @anijain2305 

### Versions

main

error_description: DebugMode silently disables torch.compile. The log shows 'skipping: forward (reason: non-infra torch dispatch mode present, this is not supported today in torch.compile, file: /data/users/ezyang/b/autoparallel/autoparallel/_testing/models/llama3.py)'. At minimum there should be an error when this occurs, but it would be better for DebugMode to work when you have a backend like aot_eager.

trigger_conditions.other_conditions: DebugMode is enabled, torch.compile is being used

add_fix_code: # Without this override, running torch.compile under DebugMode
# will force torch.compile to always use the “eager” backend
# With this, DebugMode will not take effect on torch.compile
# rewrite torch.conda as torch.ops.higher_order.cond to avoid compilation
torch.tensor(True), lambda x: x + 1, lambda x: x - 1, (x,)
sub_fix_code: torch.cond(torch.tensor(True), lambda x: x + 1, lambda x: x - 1, [x])
